messages:
Asha Lee: Quick brainstorm 1: can we structure the benchmark post around "user journeys" not raw charts? e.g., 'prototype chat' vs 'batch indexing' and then map each to a small chart + CTA.
Connor Miller: yes — makes it easier for buyers to pick the right demo. want simple KPIs: p50, tokens/sec, $/1k.
Jules Park: I'll sketch two tiny charts: one showing tail latency tradeoff, another showing marginal $ benefit per additional batch. low-bandwidth visuals.
Rhea Singh: copy thought: 'Pick a path: instant UX or economical scale.' keep it active voice and product-led.
Connor Miller (data): sample CSV for design to use: ```
scenario,p50_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k
interactive,70,120,10.8
batch-econ,450,2400,1.6
mid,160,600,4.5
```
Asha Lee: include a very small routing rule bubble: if p50 < 120ms -> fastpath (hosted), else offer "book a dedicated demo". also note model variant: fp16 vs 8-bit quant.
Jules Park: dropping a figma link with wireframes in 10m: https://www.figma.com/file/EX/bench-journeys. will label frames 'instant' and 'scale'.
Rhea Singh: for webinar: 90s live demo showing same prompt on both paths, then overlay token-cost math. two CTAs in follow-up email: 'Try the instant demo' and 'Schedule a capacity review'.
launch-bot: Reminder: cross-functional review at 3:30pm today.
Asha Lee: next steps: Jules upload mock + CSV, Connor finalizes numbers + CI notes, Rhea drafts 2 post variants (story-led and data-led). meet at 3:30. thanks all :rocket:
